not.recognized: The ticket could not be read from the photos. Try again with more light or the paper laid flatter.

extractor.unavailable: The ticket reader is not available right now.

limit.reached: You have reached today's limit of scanned tickets.

name.required: Fill in the name of the shop on the ticket.

on.invalid: The purchase day is not a valid date.

total.negative: The total of the ticket cannot be negative.

without.lines: The ticket needs at least one line.

without.name: There is a line without a name. Remove it before saving.
without.quantity: There is a line without a quantity. Remove it before saving.

empty.title: No tickets yet
empty.text: Scan a ticket or send it from the MCP and it will show up here ready to link.

getTicket.draftHint: Everything is linked. Completing it adds the stock and refreshes the catalog prices.
getTicket.receivedHint: Received: the stock is already added and the catalog prices updated. If it was a mistake, undo the reception and what went in comes back out.
getTicket.pendingHint: {{count}} not linked. A ticket goes into the pantry whole, so it cannot be completed until every line is linked.

empty.title: This ticket has no lines
empty.text: It arrived with nothing readable on it.

picker.title: Link to an article
picker.subtitle: What you pick is remembered: the next ticket with this same line arrives already linked.

deleteModal.title: Delete the ticket
deleteModal.body: The ticket and all its lines will be deleted.
deleteModal.warning: Whatever the memory already learnt stays.

scanTicket.title: Scan a ticket
scanTicket.subtitle: Take a photo of the ticket and we read it for you.
scanTicket.note: If the ticket is long, take several photos from top to bottom: they are all read together in a single pass.

capture.hint: Up to 4 photos of the same ticket, in order. Lay it flat and in good light.

review.difference: The sum of the lines does not match the printed total: {{amount}} € apart. Check the lines before saving.
review.lowConfidence: Check these fields, they were not fully legible: {{fields}}.
